figures.finding: In the Maldives the National Centre for the Arts issues film permits under its Dhivehi Film Permit regulations (Usool), registers film titles and registers artists; it screens Dhivehi films at the Olympus Theatre in Malé.

sources.said: Artist Registration Film Permit … Check Film Title Availability Check if your proposed film title is available or already registered. … Dhivehi Film 'Majunoon'
